# Media (`media`)

Raster / vector / video drawable box.

| | |
|--|--|
| **IR kind** | `media` |
| **Constructor** | `Media(…)` |
| **Child-flex props** | Yes (when parent is `layout`) |

> Distinct from `MediaLayer` (layer fill) and `MediaSource` (asset ref).

## Properties

| Property | Type |
|----------|------|
| `source` | MediaSource |
| `width` | Sizing — `.hug`, `.fill`, `.fixed(n)`, `.flex(…)`, `.aspect(…)` (number → `.fixed`) |
| `height` | Sizing — `.hug`, `.fill`, `.fixed(n)`, `.flex(…)`, `.aspect(…)` (number → `.fixed`) |
| `aspectRatio` | Ratio |
| `contentMode` | ContentMode — `.cover`, `.contain`, `.fill`, `.scaleDown` |
| `justify` | Justify — `.start`, `.center`, `.end` |
| `align` | Align — `.start`, `.center`, `.end` |
| `background` | Color | layer stack | Background | Foreground |
| `foreground` | Color | layer stack | Background | Foreground |
| `cornerRadius` | Radius | CornerRadii |
| `opacity` | Opacity |

## Child-flex properties

Available when this frame is a child of a `layout` (or as root flex against the host viewport):

| Property | Type |
|----------|------|
| `alignSelf` | AlignSelf — `.start`, `.center`, `.end`, `.stretch`, `.auto` |
| `grow` | number |
| `shrink` | number |
| `position` | Position — `.flow`, `.absolute` |
| `inset` | EdgeInsets — `EdgeInsets(…)` or uniform number sugar |
